# FDG5089

> DO NOT define conversion operators outside of a type’s domain.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 5.7.2 Conversion Operators.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: draft

## From the book

For example, `Int32`, `Int64`, `Double`, and `Decimal` are all numeric types, whereas `DateTime` is not. Therefore, there should be no conversion operator to convert `Int64` (`long)` to a `DateTime`. A constructor is preferred in such a case.

```csharp
public struct DateTime {
  public DateTime(long ticks){ ... }
}
```
